llm.summary: The skill is a clearly scoped Kia Access MCP integration that discloses credentials, local session persistence, vehicle location/status reads, and confirm-gated vehicle commands.

dimensions.detail: The skill can access sensitive vehicle data, including location, and can control climate, charging, and optionally door locks, but these authorities are directly tied to the stated Kia Access use case and are mode-limited.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup uses npx to run the kiaaccess-mcp package and requires the user to provide Kia credentials in MCP environment variables; this is disclosed and coherent with the integration purpose.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are specific about when to use the skill, require explicit confirmation for commands, warn against retrying failed logins, and explain command result semantics and stale reads.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact discloses local remember-me token storage, silent refresh, optional exported refresh token use, and a confirm-gated forget-session tool; the token is sensitive because it bypasses MFA.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capabilities match the stated purpose: reading Kia vehicle status/location/charge data and issuing Kia vehicle commands through the user's own Kia account.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving this MCP server access to your Kia account. Use KIA_WRITE_MODE=none for read-only access unless you need remote commands, avoid exporting or sharing the refresh token, and require explicit user confirmation before unlocking or otherwise commanding a real vehicle.
